# ── Game sources ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Every .cpp in src/ (except main.cpp) is compiled into defender_lib.
# The list below is generated by update_cmakelists.sh (run by `make`):
# do not edit it by hand.
target_sources(defender_lib
    PRIVATE
        # <SOURCES>
        core/Game.cpp
        defender_lib.cpp
        entities/Enemy.cpp
        entities/EnemyDefinitions.cpp
        entities/EnemyFactory.cpp
        entities/Projectile.cpp
        entities/Tower.cpp
        managers/EntityManager.cpp
        managers/ResourceManager.cpp
        managers/WaveManager.cpp
        map/Map.cpp
        map/MapGenerator.cpp
        map/MapRenderer.cpp
        map/Maze.cpp
        states/GameOverState.cpp
        states/MenuState.cpp
        states/PauseState.cpp
        states/PlayState.cpp
        # </SOURCES>
)

# ── Executable ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
add_executable(defender main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(defender PRIVATE defender_lib)

# Copy SFML DLLs next to the executable on Windows (no-op on Linux/macOS)
if(WIN32)
    add_custom_command(TARGET defender POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            $<TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS:defender>
            $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:defender>
        COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS
    )
endif()
